jumps.name: stationary-first
checks: Anticipation holds the collider grounded at 0.30s after Space (observed grounded=True, rise=0.000m). Immediate launch skips source frames 0..19.
The actual outgoing airborne pose stays frozen while the separate landing clock blends in.
One Space press produces exactly one launch (observed 1).
Physical takeoff follows preparation at 0.55..0.80s (observed 0.650s).
Runtime jump states sample the uncropped 0..50 Girl_Jump source (observed Girl_Jump, 1.667s).
Jump retains the configured 1.2m/-20 physics (measured rise 1.143m).
The actual physics apex uses the source apex pose near frame 25 (observed 24.77).
First physical floor contact uses the landing pose near source frame 30 (observed 29.62).
Contact blending avoids a large adjacent-frame knee snap (largest change 13.3 degrees).
LandingRecovery progresses from contact through at least ten intermediate poses to full source end frame 50 before Locomotion (observed 33.00 -> 50.00, intermediate samples=33).
Ground contact preserves visible landing/recovery before locomotion resumes.
The first preparation frames avoid the cropped-clip knee snap (largest adjacent knee change 4.9 degrees).
Fixed-camera proof includes anticipation, takeoff, apex, first contact and recovery.
Continuous proof covers the full first jump at 30 frames per second.

scenarios.name: water-reset-during-preparation
checks: Scenario starts from a settled player in Locomotion.
Interruption occurs during grounded preparation before any physical launch.
The actual scene water reset still targets the integrated player.
Cancellation immediately clears velocity, stale motion data and active jump/recovery flags.
Water reset prevents a delayed takeoff from the interrupted sequence.
The reset player settles without resuming preparation, flight or recovery.
The restored player has a fresh grounded sample before requesting another jump.
After interruption or fallback, a fresh Space request again plays grounded anticipation.
The restored player accepts exactly one fresh animated jump.
The fresh animated jump completes and returns to grounded locomotion.

scenarios.name: ledge-fall-from-locomotion

Falling source time stays monotonic until contact.

A ledge fall progresses through the full landing recovery to frame 50.
Fall/contact transitions avoid a large adjacent-frame knee snap (largest change 27.8 degrees).

scenarios.name: animator-disabled-after-launch-queued
checks: Scenario starts from a settled player in Locomotion.
Intercepted source frame 19 while grounded, with an accepted preparation and no physical launch yet.
Disabling Animator after source frame 19 cancels the queued impulse before the next movement update; no ghost takeoff occurs.
After cancelling the old queued request, a fresh Space with Animator still disabled produces one immediate fallback jump.
The fresh Animator-disabled fallback retains the original physical jump height.

scenarios.name: fully-blocked-headroom
checks: Scenario starts from a settled player in Locomotion.
Fully blocked headroom allows one launch attempt but prevents a physical upward flight (rise 0.000m).
A launch blocked by the ceiling finishes recovery and releases the jump sequence instead of waiting forever for an airborne sample.
